verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents per-user API keys and audit logs in its self-hosted setup, and entity-scoped memory (user/agent/app/session) for data isolation, which is adjacent to least-privilege credentialing. However there is no evidence of actual permission/scope-based API keys (e.g., read-only vs write, restricted operations) — the docs only show per-user key issuance, not fine-grained privilege scoping. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission levels on API keys, role-based access control, and any documentation of restricting an agent's key to a subset of actions or memories.
